notes.title: What A Trash Game Release!
notes.notes:
"What A Trash Game!" has been officially released on steam. The release comes with multiplayer game modes, an overhaul of the map, music and more. Enjoy the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926800/9d21f5d43210e348b54235e032222c7048f5eeb3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.21.0.146 Beta - Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926800/9d21f5d43210e348b54235e032222c7048f5eeb3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added free-for-all and co-op multiplayer game modes
[*]Added two character models
[*]Added many new features to the map including a light house, 2 wharfs, a yacht, a wooden bridge, several new environmental assets and more
[*]Added music
[*]Added resolution and window mode settings
[/list]

[h1]Changed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Switched to a third person camera system
[*]Modified color grading and post effects
[*]Updated the map and minimap with the new map features
[*]Fixed terrain shader issues
[*]Improved all Steam API code (leaderboard, achievements, stats, multiplayer)
[*]Fixed a ton of bugs
[/list]

[h1]Removed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed crouch
[/list]

[h1]Whats Next?[/h1]
Before release I need to create a couple of video clips including a gameplay trailer and a cinematic trailer. I would also like to do some final testing before releasing. I expect the game to be ready for release within the next few days!
